title: Report magic numbers.
summary: Magic number is a numeric literal that is not defined as a constant and hence it's unclear what the purpose of this number is. It's better to declare such numbers as constants and give them a proper name. It is in the style rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.0.0.

title: A multi-line loop was found that does not have braces.
summary: These should be added to improve readability. It is in the style rule set. detekt does not run it by default.

title: Map.get() with not-null assertion operator (!!) can result in a NullPointerException.
summary: Consider usage of map.getValue(), map.getOrDefault() or map.getOrElse() instead. It is in the standard-library rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.21.0. It needs type resolution.

title: If a source file contains only a single non-private top-level class or object, the file name should reflect the case-sensitive name plus the .kt extension.
summary: It is in the naming rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.0.0.
